## Summary

The morning-manifest post from the author of the Pinealon/ADHD-replacement article — his sign-off "The way of the biohacker" recurs. Anecdote first: first-ever L-Theanine dose the night before → "slept like I had been hit by a truck. Thankfully I'm unemployed and have nowhere to be!" Backed by photo 2, his tracker readout: 8h 19m in bed, 97% sleep efficiency, REM 1h 36m, deep 2h 11m, in bed 02:48 → out of bed 11:07. Then the daily stack, verbatim from the full text:

- **T3** (photo 1 shows Cynomel 25 mcg — pharmaceutical liothyronine)
- **Bromantane**
- **Whole food Vitamin C**
- **Glucosamine** (Cytoplan glucosamine HCl)
- **BPC-157 & KPV** (gray-market gut-healing / injury-repair peptides)
- **L-Tyrosine** ("Extra Strength" bottle in the photo)
- **B complex** (Raw Vitamin B-Complex with folate + riboflavin)
- **Choline & Inositol** (Codeage, 100 veg caps)
- **Meldonium** (Grindeks — the original Latvian brand, by OCR)
- **Tadalafil**
- **Urolithin A & CoQ10**

Closer: "Work will be getting crushed, and the spin bike will hate to see me coming for some zone two later. Time to change the world again!"

Photo 1's OCR (Cynomel, Tyrosine, Cytoplan glucosamine, Grindeks meldonium, B-complex, Codeage choline/inositol) confirms the list is a literal table photo, not aspiration — the bottles match the text one for one.

## Why it matters

Sixth capture in RD's active biohacking/cognition thread and the second from this exact author. Where the Nov-10 note was his protocol *article*, this is the daily *manifest* — what actually goes down each morning. It threads the earlier notes directly: Bromantane is the "core pillar" of his ADHD-replacement thesis ([[2026-11-10-zygomatic03-pinealon-social-fluidity]]); daily tadalafil is the exact play argued in [[2026-11-10-hoostethics-low-dose-tadalafil]]; meldonium sits in the same Russian/Latvian pharma family as his Bromantane and Mexidol picks; and the Driada catalog ([[2026-11-05-driada-medical-catalog]]) is the vendor lane several of these ship through. New to the thread here: T3, meldonium, BPC-157/KPV, urolithin A + CoQ10, tyrosine, choline/inositol, glucosamine.

Skepticism gates: n=1 self-report by a stack influencer whose article carries his own vendor discount code (flagged in the prior note). **T3 (Cynomel) without documented hypothyroidism is the sharpest risk in the list** — exogenous thyroid suppresses TSH and carries muscle-loss, bone-density and arrhythmia risks, and nothing in his public output shows bloodwork justifying it. Meldonium is WADA-banned (same actoprotector-family flag as Bromantane) with Russian-only evidence; BPC-157/KPV are research peptides with no human trials. The sleep screenshot is a single night that cannot isolate L-Theanine from the rest of the stack (and a 02:48 bedtime / 11:07 rise confounds the "good morning" framing). UAE posture unchanged from the earlier notes: several of these are prescription-controlled or customs-risky, and RD's stated stance on 11-10 was checking, not ordering — reference-only, no task filed.
